description: This Java source file defines the ExceptionDialogFragment class, which is a UI component for displaying exception details in a dialog within an Android application. It handles rendering error messages, stack traces, and related tips, and provides options to copy the exception info to the clipboard or close the dialog.

classes.name: ExceptionDialogFragment
classes.description: A dialog fragment for displaying exception details, including stack trace and tips, with options to copy details or close.

methods.name: onAttach
methods.description: Attaches the fragment and initializes the list of throwables from arguments.

methods.name: onCreateDialog
methods.description: Creates and configures the dialog UI with exception details, tips, and options.

methods.description: Creates a new instance of the dialog fragment with a list of exceptions.
